DE.logoExplainer: The Deutsche Bundesbank wordmark: a vertical blue bar beside a column of gold five-pointed stars, followed by the blue "Deutsche Bundesbank" lettering stacked on two lines. The blue (#0068A5) and gold (#FDBB32) echo the euro's palette; the stars nod to the European constellation while the bar is a spare modernist mark for Germany's Eurosystem national central bank.
